Classes & Courses

Makeup

Personal Makeup

A one-day personal makeup class. Master foundation matching, contouring, eye looks, and everyday glam with hands-on coaching, all materials provided.

Basic Fundamentals

Corporate Signature Look

Special Effects

SFX Masterclass

PHP 40,000

Professional 10 days →

How Enrollment Works

Class sizes stay small so every student gets direct instructor time. Seats fill early; inquire as soon as you know your dates.

All classes run face to face at the Quezon City studio, Monday to Saturday. Intake dates open as they are set, or contact us to hold your seat.
